night photography

Oct 22, 2025

nighttime after rain, in search of neon lights. i love these neon obscura and teal obscure settings for a cinematic, night-time, wong-kar wai award-winning film looks. some of these pictures also remind me of my all time favoriate k-drama “light shop”. i love how they turned out, i just wished that there are more neon and artificial lights here in this city. i guess it’s time for a trip to asia.
